Programs & Degrees By attending Richard Bland College and earning an Associate Degree, you will have completed the first two years toward the Baccalaureate Degree. Programs & Degrees Spotlight on Student Excellence RICHARD BLAND COLLEGE APPOINTS KENNETH ALEXANDER, Ph.D. AS NEW INTERIM PRESIDENT Following a national search, the Richard Bland College Board of Visitors today announced the appointment of Kenneth Cooper Alexander, Ph.D., as Interim President, effective May 11. Dr. Alexander will succeed Dr. Debbie L. Sydow who last year announced her intent to step down as president in June after 14 years of distinguished service to the College. COME STUDY WITH OUR FACULTY MEET ABBIGAYLE POIRIER Abbigayle Poirier is the Assistant Professor of Art at Richard Bland College. Her evolving artistic philosophy, which is rooted in exploration and self-discovery, shapes both her studio practice and her commitment to helping students find their own creative voice. MEET DAVE MORGAN, PH.D. Dr. Dave Morgan’s philosophy as an RBC professor, and specifically as a professor of science, which is what he teaches, is to instruct students, not just about how to use the formulas and how to understand the ideas of science – but I teach them how to think like a scientist. MEET DAVE MAJEWSKI Dave Majewski teaches Communications and theatre at Richard Bland College. He likes to say, “When students come to my class I like to let them know that whatever it takes for them to be successful, I will always be there for them.” MEET ABBIGAYLE POIRIER Abbigayle Poirier is the Assistant Professor of Art at Richard Bland College. On-Air RBC The “On-Air RBC” Podcast at Richard Bland College brings you inside the conversations shaping our campus—featuring enrollment strategies, student success stories, enrollment insights and leadership perspectives. Available on Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music, YouTube and Spotify, “On-Air RBC” connects you directly to the people and ideas driving student success. Tune in and discover how Richard Bland College helps you start smart, save money, and build a clear path to a four-year degree—and beyond. “On-Air RBC” Podcast — your source for all things Richard Bland College. Residence Life RBC residence halls are designed to promote a sense of community and foster personal growth. Apartment-style living includes shared rooms with common areas where students can socialize, study, and build relationships with peers. Resident Assistants are assigned to each hall to provide peer support, organize events, and enforce policies that ensure a positive living environment. Living on campus at RBC provides students with easy access to academic resources and faculty, making it easier to engage in their studies. Student safety is a priority at RBC, with residence halls featuring secure access systems and 24-hour staff availability. SUBSCRIBE TO US ON SOCIAL MEDIA RBC INSTAGRAM RBC Instagram has a variety of the latest reels and uploaded short video content for you to get to know the college. Please subscribe and become a follower so that you can view, comment and like our posts, shared by other students and friends of the college. RBC YOUTUBE RBC YouTube has the latest commercials, mini-documentaries, student, faculty and alumni profiles that you can search for and watch our videos. Users subscribe and follow our channel which has managed to make a name for itself with a fast rise to over 5 million views. RBC FACEBOOK RBC Facebook is our social media platform that allows parents, alumni, students and friends of the college to share content and engage with all aspects of the college. We make it easy for you to connect with all the people that your care about, online while sending messages and post status updates. RBC ATHLETICS The official Instagram home of Richard Bland College Athletics. Get the latest schedules, scores, news and video reels from RBC Nation. The Statesmen have 14 athletic teams, making it a top 2-year school for athletics in the Commonwealth of Virginia. Achieving Independence Welcome to the Fall edition of Inside RBC Magazine! In this issue, we explore the remarkable journey that led Richard Bland College to gain its independence, marking a bold new chapter in its history. Discover how cutting-edge innovation is coming to RBC with the introduction of the world’s most advanced humanoid robot, and how Virtual Reality is hitting the road with our brand-new mobile VR unit. Plus, learn about the transformative $3.9 million Impact Grant from SCHEV, aimed at expanding paid internships and work-based learning opportunities for RBC students.
